arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IN (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'status',b.status,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'hold',(SELECT json_object('flight',h.flight_id,'passenger',h.passenger_id) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.booking_id IN ('bkg_c744f8b0e6d3575b82d096223222bbf4','bkg_040ff474919b504f90cfc29d13417bc0') UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE trace_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') OR message LIKE '%bkg_a737709a17ff502aa634984173e70010%' OR message LIKE '%bkg_10a43aaca5c65992aa1aba922b649de4%' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'event' AS kind,json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) AS data FROM (SELECT * FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 5) UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id LIMIT 30) UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('id',charge_id,'booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status='pending') UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'missing_checkin',json_object('id',b.booking_id,'event_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id),'checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.booking_id='bkg_c744f8b0e6d3575b82d096223222bbf4'
